$docs.manifest: schemaVersion pins this contract. organization/network/inheritance describe tenancy and franchise lineage; surfaces is the exact deployable app matrix; providers records who owns each external dependency.
$docs.identity: slug is the tenant key everywhere (folder name, brands.slug, onboarding); bundleId/scheme and kioskBundleId/kioskScheme feed the per-brand Expo configs; easProjectId and kioskEasProjectId come from each binary's separate `eas init`.
$docs.tokens: Hydrated into packages/ui's ThemeProvider and stored on brands.brand_config. Colors are #RRGGBB. fontDisplay/fontBody must be family names from the supported font registry (maintained in packages/ui/src/font-registry.ts, landing in the next phase). Optional tokens.ramp holds advanced overrides for the app's internal palette, keyed exactly like the legacy `colors` export -- note ramp.surface is the app screen surface, distinct from top-level tokens.surface used by splash/shared components; when omitted, the steps are derived from the seed colors by the theme resolver. Derive the palette from the brand's own assets -- never from any other product's look (docs/DO-NOT-RESEMBLE.md).
$docs.copy: Every user-facing brand string. Keys the apps read are listed in packages/ui/src/copy.ts (DEFAULT_COPY); unknown keys are allowed and ignored. {placeholders} survive until formatted.
$docs.features: Rule 5 flags, mirrored to the brands row by onboarding.
$docs.fees: Rule 3: platform take in basis points; above tierThresholdCents of gross in a calendar month (per location) later payments use feeBpsTier2. Confirm per contract before onboarding.
$docs.locations: Canonical list of locations created by onboarding. hours uses 24h HH:MM in each location's timezone; [] = closed. Legacy location is accepted as one entry during migration, but never declare both shapes.
$docs.illustrations: Optional named palettes for brand illustration work (e.g. the rewards cup). Free-form; read by the app's illustration components.
$docs.business: Contact + legal identity the apps print (error screens, receipts, calendar notes, gift codes). monogram is the 1-3 letter fallback mark; giftCodePrefix prefixes every issued gift code.
$docs.information: Optional overrides for the five reference pages behind More (location, resources, faq, order-policy, privacy). Every page has a brand-neutral default, and the location page is derived from `location` and `business` above rather than retyped -- leave this out entirely and the app still renders all five. Per page: eyebrow/title/summary/webPath/action replace the default string; `rows` replaces the default rows; `addRows` appends to whatever rows are in effect. A row is {title, detail}; a row missing either is dropped rather than rendered blank.
$docs.modifiers.json: Sibling file: option groups per item slug, in the JSONB shape packages/engine/src/menu-pricing.ts reads -- each slug maps to an array of groups {id, name, select: 'single' | 'multi', required, maxChoices, dependsOn?, choices: [{id, name, priceDeltaCents}]}. Optional; items absent from it sell plain. Every key must be a slug in menu.csv -- onboarding validates that.

tax.$docs: Optional. Each authority on the brand's sales-tax licence, as a fractional rate (0.029 = 2.9%). The order API prices tax from this list, one rounded row per authority; absent or empty means no tax is charged.

loyalty.$docs: Optional. tiers is the earning ladder the apps render and earn against -- name (free text), minimumAnnualPoints (points in the trailing year), pointsPerDollar, description, perks[]. Leave it empty to inherit a generic four-rung ladder; write it and the lowest rung must sit at 0, or the whole ladder is ignored rather than half-applied. Keep the names in step with board.tiers, which is the same ladder on the public wall. rewards is what points buy, served by /api/loyalty/redeem; points_cost is integer points.

board.$docs: Optional. The in-store order board. showGuestStatus defaults to false -- a tier badge on a screen the whole room can read is guest information, so a brand opts in rather than inheriting it. tiers is the ladder app.loyalty_tier_for matches against loyalty_accounts.lifetime_points; slug is the stable key (never rename it), label is what the badge says, tone picks a semantic token (muted | accent | success | primary) and color overrides it with an explicit #RRGGBB, icon is the single mark drawn in front of the label (falls back to copy.rewardMark). Both are editable in HQ under Brand config. appUrl must be absolute https -- it is encoded into the QR panel and scanned by strangers who cannot see where it points.

kiosk.$docs: The lobby kiosk's flow. Shape and rules: packages/domain/src/kiosk-flow.ts. EVERY FIELD IS OPTIONAL -- delete this whole block and a device still opens on a first screen derived from your menu.csv categories. Fill it in when you want a say over the order.

attract.$docs: What the kiosk shows for most of its life, so it is the shop's face more than a menu is. headline null falls back to the brand name.

entry.$docs: The first screen. `nodes` is YOUR call -- a coffee shop leads with drinks, a bakery leads with box sizes. categoryId is the category TITLE exactly as it appears in menu.csv, because menu_categories has no slug. A tile pointing at a category you later rename is dropped and reported rather than rendered as a dead button. Leave `nodes` out entirely to have them derived from your menu. Max 12; emphasis is hero | standard | minor and is drawn as size.
entry.prompt: What can we help with today?

kiosk.$familyDocs: 'item' for a shop whose SKU is a drink or a dish (size, then options). 'pack' for a shop whose SKU is a container the guest fills -- a box of six. Never inferred from your menu: changing the metaphor is a decision, not a guess.
kiosk.$identifyDocs: An optional identify step that must never block an anonymous purchase. mode off | optional; methods phone | scan.
kiosk.$tendersDocs: card | cash settle an order; stored_value | gift_card reduce what is due and need the brand's stored_value feature switched on. A list with no settling tender has card added to it.
kiosk.$tipDocs: Integer cents, never float dollars. Leave disabled unless you want a tip prompt.
kiosk.$surveyDocs: An optional post-order attribution question. Groups need at least one option each or the survey turns itself off.
kiosk.$idleDocs: How long an abandoned session survives. Warn first, then clear -- the next guest must never inherit a stranger's bag. A container shop should give longer: filling a twelve-box takes longer than picking one latte. Clamped to 15s-10min, and the reset is always pushed clear of the warning.
